restrictions: Target sha256-r39-prefix-v1: SHA-256 steps 0..38 on every padded 512-bit block, standard SHA-256 IV once before block 0, standard FIPS 180-4 padding, Davies-Meyer feed-forward, equality on all eight 32-bit digest words; outputs two distinct 128-byte (two-block) messages M0 || M1 and M0 || M1' with equal second-block chaining values (and hence equal padded digests).

Construction: ordinary two-block differential attack using the bipartite claw decomposition W16(a0, u) = g + (sigma0(u) - u) - F_even(a0, CV1) (mod 2^32) at step 16 solved via a 65,536-slot (768 KiB) van Oorschot-Wiener (vOW) distinguished-point walk, the self-contained 584-byte Table 23 dense base (ePrint 2026/1120) derived in 2^36 one-time preprocessing and verified in O(1) online memory, exact GF(2) affine subspaces on rows 19..22, and the accepted event across steps 18..38 with step 20 evaluated on signed modular differences.

Cost: total work <= 2^121.30 target compressions (C = 2812 word operations per 39-step compression). Packed 7-lane x 36-bit kernel traced at 67 instructions for Stage-2 recovery and 71 instructions for Stage-1 with the 4-op SWAR zero-field DP detector ((out & 0x7F) + 0x7F) ^ 0x80 & 0x80 (14 peak live registers, 0 spills in 64 registers; Stage-1 SWAR batch 74 ops -> 2^120.9951 under simd7 and 2^120.5863 under stream7; Stage-1 unpacked 27-op lane-by-lane loop 96 ops/batch -> 2^121.2290 under simd7, also covered by 2^121.30).

Per-claw success probability 2^-118.357707 (exact row-8 and row-9 side conditions in_F8 and in_F9: 585/524288 = 2^-9.807707, exact row-17 transition |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 -> 2^-32.0 at W17 = 0x71e9ba98 under H5-w17-conditional-uniformity, and tail rows 18..38 probability 2^-76.55 from a 64-seed zero-stall SMC study with N = 16,384 particles, 99% Student-t lower confidence bound; point estimate 2^-76.1838). Required distinct claws N_claws = 2^117.341155 for success probability at least 0.39.

Memory 823,296 bytes < 2^20 bytes (786,432-byte vOW table + 18,432-byte code + 2,048-byte register file + 16,384-byte advice and scratch), giving memory_log2_bytes = 20 and combined Pareto score 121.30 + max(0, 20 - 20) = 121.30.

heuristics.statement: For each random first-block chaining value CV1, the bipartite claw walk on F_step(x) produces opposite-parity pairs (a0, u) satisfying F_step(a0) = F_step(u), which with a1 = recover_a1(a0, u, CV1) yields W16(a0, u) = g = 0xbca1c321 (the unique G16 word with a non-empty G17 fiber), and downstream survival on this fixed target matches the product of prefix side-condition, row-17, and tail probabilities.
heuristics.scope: Validity of the row-16 claw construction and fixed-target success probability per distinct claw.
heuristics.extrapolation: Lemma 2.1 and Lemma 3.1 prove W16(a0, u) = g + (sigma0(u) - u) - F_even(a0, CV1) (mod 2^32) algebraically with probability 1 across steps 0..15. Verified with 0 mismatches across all 135,412 distinct claws in the 65,536-slot vOW benchmark and across 16 multi-step vOW DP trail collisions (la != lb) recovered end-to-end via Stage-1 DP detection, 64K-slot table collision, and Stage-2 7-lane packed recovery in experiment:r39-claw-vow, plus 16 live downward-inverted 39-step SFS colliding pairs in experiment:r39-tail-sfs.
heuristics.limitations: Because f(u) = sigma0(u) - u is non-bijective (covering 63.4% of 2^32 values), vOW-recovered claws weight u toward values with larger f-preimage multiplicity; H4, H5, and H6 explicitly test and bound any resulting correlation with the side conditions, W17, and the tail.

heuristics.statement: Under the 64-register 256-bit word-RAM cost model (C = 2812 word operations per 39-step compression), 7 independent 32-bit lanes packed at a 36-bit stride with 4-bit guard bands execute one F_step evaluation in 67 instructions for Stage-2 recovery and 71 instructions for Stage-1 (including the 4-op SWAR zero-field DP detector ((out & 0x7F) + 0x7F) ^ 0x80 & 0x80) using 14 peak live registers and 0 register spills.
heuristics.scope: Word-operation count per 7-lane packed F_step evaluation in Stage 1 (74 ops/batch SWAR, 96 ops/batch unpacked) and Stage 2 (69 ops/batch).
heuristics.extrapolation: Same 7-lane x 36-bit convention as the accepted 39-step baseline 8681f9bd (shrho.py) and f86da3c1. Every instruction of both the 67-op Stage-2 kernel and the 71-op Stage-1 SWAR DP kernel is traced by Tracer (build_traced_step), allocated via linear scan (allocate -> 14 registers, 0 spills), and verified bit-for-bit against scalar F_step and against unpacked lane-by-lane DP detection across 112 lanes per active trial (1,792 lanes total) in experiment:r39-claw-vow with 0 mismatches.
heuristics.limitations: Our claimed bound 121.30 also covers the 96-op unpacked Stage-1 loop (where all 7 lanes are extracted and tested individually in 27 ops, giving 121.2290 total work under simd7).

heuristics.statement: A 65,536-slot (768 KiB) vOW distinguished-point search with dp_bits = 7 and max_steps = 2048 yields one deduplicated distinct claw (a0, u) per 35,396.61 word operations (12.5877 target compressions = 2^3.65394) under immediate 2-walk-in-7-lane Stage-2 recovery with 74-op SWAR Stage-1 batches (simd7), 41,626.89 word operations (14.8033 compressions = 2^3.88785) under 96-op unpacked Stage-1 batches (simd7), or 26,662.69 word operations (9.4818 compressions = 2^3.24516) under 7-lane buffered recovery (stream7).
heuristics.scope: Total word operations per deduplicated distinct claw.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured directly by executing the full two-stage vOW cycle across 268,435,704 walk evaluations (4 CVs x 2^26 evals: 33,820, 33,772, 33,962, and 33,858 distinct claws per CV, relative SD 0.23%; 38,347,958 main batches, 2,092,676 DP hits, 330,778 value matches, 162,983 raw claws, 135,412 deduplicated distinct claws) in ledger() (--ledger) and verified on 16 live multi-step vOW DP trail collisions (la != lb, 4 <= la, lb <= 102) via recover_7pairs_packed in experiment:r39-claw-vow.
heuristics.limitations: Both the 74-op SWAR Stage-1 regime (2^120.9951) and the 96-op unpacked Stage-1 regime (2^121.2290) lie strictly below our claimed 2^121.30 bound.

heuristics.statement: A deduplicated vOW claw (a0, u) satisfies the row-8 condition in_F8(W8) and the row-9 condition in_F9(W9) with joint probability p8 * p9 = (9/128) * (65/4096) = 585 / 524,288 = 2^-9.807707.
heuristics.scope: Prefix side-condition survival factor in the per-claw success probability.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exhaustively enumerated over all 2^32 words W8 (301,989,888 / 2^32 = 9/128) and W9 (68,157,440 / 2^32 = 65/4096), and empirically verified directly on the 135,412 distinct vOW-recovered claws (157 joint passes observed across the 4 CVs [38, 36, 45, 38] vs 151.10 expected, ratio 1.039) as well as across 4,096 seeded candidates and 16 live multi-step vOW F89 trails in experiment:r39-claw-vow and 16 live SFS pairs in experiment:r39-tail-sfs.
heuristics.limitations: Empirical verification on 135,412 live vOW claws has binomial standard error sqrt(151.1) = 12.29 passes (+/- 0.12 bits).

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on W16(a0, u) = 0xbca1c321, W8 in F8, and W9 in F9, the unconstrained step-17 message word W17(a0, u) = sigma1(W15) + W10 + sigma0(W2(a0, a1)) + u (mod 2^32) hits the unique valid row-17 word 0x71e9ba98 in G17(0xbca1c321) with probability p17 = 2^-32.
heuristics.scope: Row-17 transition probability p17 = 2^-32 in the per-claw success probability.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exact row-17 enumeration (solve_row_exact) proves |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 (0x71e9ba98). By Lemma 2.1(5), W17(a0, u) is randomized by sigma0(W2(a0, a1)) where W2 depends on step-2 S0(a1) + MAJ(a1, a0, cv0) and S1(e1) + CH(e1, e0, cv4) that do not appear in W16, W8, or W9. Empirically verified on the 135,412 distinct vOW claws: individual byte matches to 0x71e9ba98 are [517, 486, 525, 526] vs 528.95 +/- 22.95 expected, 16-bit prefix matches (0xba98) are 4 vs 2.07 expected, and conditioned on the 157 claws passing F8 and F9, low-4-bit matches (W17 & 0xF) == 0x8 are 13/157 = 0.0828 vs 1/16 = 0.0625 expected.
heuristics.limitations: Direct 32-bit hits on 0x71e9ba98 have rate 2^-32, so empirical validation tests marginal byte/16-bit prefix uniformity across 135,412 vOW claws and 4-bit conditional uniformity on F8 cap F9 claws, complemented by exact 32-bit hits in the 16 live SFS inversions in experiment:r39-tail-sfs.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on W16(a0, u) = 0xbca1c321, W17(a0, u) = 0x71e9ba98, and the row-8 and row-9 side conditions, the conditional probability that the reconstructed message pair satisfies the accepted differential event across steps 18..38 (with step 20 on signed modular differences and full 39-step digest equality at step 38) is at least p_tail = 2^-76.55.
heuristics.scope: Tail (rows 18..38) survival factor p_tail in the per-claw success probability.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured across 64 independent Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) runs with N = 16,384 particles per stage starting from random CV1 and random claw pairs passing rows 8, 9, 16, and 17: 64 / 64 seeds completed with 0 stalls (Table 7.1), mean(log2 p_tail) = -76.335945, sample SD = 0.7168, log2(mean(p_tail)) = -76.183798, and one-sided 99% Student-t lower confidence bound = -76.5498 (conservatively rounded to -76.55). In experiment:r39-tail-sfs, each active trial constructs the exact GF(2) affine subspaces on rows 19..22, executes a live seed-driven SMC rollout (32 x 512 = 16,384 rollouts/trial), and inverts a step-38 rollout via invert_rollout_to_sfs into a fresh 39-step SFS colliding pair.
heuristics.limitations: The 99% Student-t lower confidence bound (-76.55 vs point mean -76.18) provides a 0.37-bit buffer against finite-sample SMC variance.

heuristics.statement: Evaluating N_claws = 2^117.341155 deduplicated distinct claws across 2^102.294 independent random first blocks M0 yields a full 39-step SHA-256 two-block collision with probability at least 1 - exp(-N_claws * p_claw) = 0.39 (lambda = 0.49429635).
heuristics.scope: Conversion of per-claw success probability p_claw = 2^-118.357707 into total required distinct claws for success probability >= 0.39.
heuristics.extrapolation: Within each CV1 table (65,536 slots, 2^26 evaluations), duplicate walk collisions are explicitly stripped (135,412 distinct claws out of 162,983 raw claws in ledger), and distinct first blocks M0 induce independent step functions F_step. Each CV1 contributes only 33,853.0 distinct claws (success probability ~ 2^-103.3 per first block), so inter-block successes are independent Bernoulli trials.
heuristics.limitations: Standard Poisson approximation for rare events across 2^102.294 independent first blocks.
